summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of the Hilton Garden Inn Austin Downtown, a 254-room hotel, for net cash proceeds of ~$26.4 million. The sale closed on June 18, 2026, per an April 30, 2026, purchase agreement with JMIR Acquisitions, LLC. The registrant also repaid ~$25.7 million to the mortgage lender on the property. No board recommendation, advisor, break fee, or premium was stated; the transaction appears to be an asset-level disposition by the REIT. Watch for use of proceeds and further portfolio streamlining.
